venira.avoid_when: you need the worktree state (git_status) or a remote PR’s head branch (pr_list).
venira.output_kind: list: current, branches[] {name, current, commit, upstream, track, remote}, branch_count. create/switch/delete: branch, commit/created/switched/deleted/force. Missing branch gives not_found; duplicate name gives conflict.
venira.speed_profile: fast; one branch call, remote branches optional.
venira.use_when: you need the current branch, want to branch off HEAD, switch branches, or prune a merged branch.

description:
List local (and optionally remote-tracking) branches, or create/switch/delete one.
Use when: you need the current branch, want to branch off HEAD, switch branches, or prune a merged branch.
Avoid when: you need the worktree state (git_status) or a remote PR’s head branch (pr_list).
Output: list: current, branches[] {name, current, commit, upstream, track, remote}, branch_count. create/switch/delete: branch, commit/created/switched/deleted/force. Missing branch gives not_found; duplicate name gives conflict.

action.description: list: local branches (add include_remote=true for origin); current: just the checked-out branch; create/switch/delete: local branch.

force.description: true allows deleting an unmerged branch (git branch -D); false uses -d.

from.description: Optional start ref for action=create (default: HEAD).

include_remote.description: true includes remote-tracking branches in action=list.

name: git_branch
title: Git branch
